Escape to Tranquility at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

Nestled amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Hanoi, Vietnam, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offers a serene and luxurious escape for travelers seeking tranquility and relaxation. With its 4.5-star rating, this enchanting hotel promises a memorable stay with its impeccable service and stunning surroundings. As you step into Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, you will be greeted by a warm and inviting ambiance. The hotel boasts a total of 55 beautifully appointed rooms, each thoughtfully designed to provide the utmost comfort and convenience. Whether you choose a cozy Deluxe Room or indulge in the spaciousness of a Suite, you can expect a haven of tranquility where you can unwind and rejuvenate. Check-in at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat begins from 02:00 PM, allowing you to start your retreat at your own pace. The check-out time is until 11:00 AM, giving you ample time to savor the hotel's serene surroundings before bidding farewell. Located just 55 kilometers away from the city center, this idyllic retreat offers a peaceful respite from the hustle and bustle of urban life. The journey to the airport takes approximately 120 minutes, ensuring a seamless transition between your mountain getaway and your return home. Please note that Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat has a child policy in place. While children are welcome to stay at the hotel, they may be subject to additional charges. The hotel's friendly staff will be more than happy to provide you with detailed information regarding the child policy, ensuring a hassle-free stay for you and your loved ones. So, whether you are seeking a romantic escape, a family vacation, or a peaceful retreat, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat is the perfect destination to create lasting memories.

Unwind and Indulge in Luxurious Entertainment Facilities at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, you can unwind and indulge in a wide range of luxurious entertainment facilities that will leave you feeling rejuvenated and pampered. Whether you're in the mood for a refreshing drink or a relaxing massage, this retreat has it all. If you're in need of some pampering, head to the spa and indulge in a soothing massage or unwind in the hot tub, sauna, or steam room. The spa also offers a range of treatments to revitalize your mind, body, and soul. For nature lovers, the retreat boasts a beautiful garden where you can take a leisurely stroll and immerse yourself in the serene surroundings. If you prefer to relax indoors, the shared lounge/TV area provides a cozy space to unwind and catch up on your favorite shows. Don't forget to visit the gift/souvenir shop to pick up some unique mementos to remember your stay. With its exceptional entertainment facilities, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxation and indulgence. Whether you're seeking tranquility or excitement, this retreat has something to cater to every guest's needs.

Our sports facilities are designed to provide you with a wide range of options to stay active and fit during your stay. Whether you prefer to hit the gym, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, or explore the lush surroundings on our hiking trails, we have something for everyone. Our state-of-the-art fitness center is fully equipped with the latest exercise machines and equipment, allowing you to maintain your workout routine even while on vacation. With our 24-hour access, you can exercise at your convenience, whether it's early in the morning or late at night. Best of all, our fitness center is completely free for all guests, so you can stay in shape without any extra charges. For those who prefer to enjoy the great outdoors, our outdoor pool is the perfect place to cool off and unwind. Take a leisurely swim or simply relax by the poolside, soaking up the sun and enjoying the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. And if you're up for a more adventurous activity, our hiking trails offer a chance to explore the natural beauty of Ba Vi National Park. Lace up your hiking boots and embark on a journey through lush forests, cascading waterfalls, and stunning vistas.
